entries.title: Array out of range in OnTick execution
entries.symptom: EA halts execution on tick processing with error code 4002.
entries.tried: Checked loop bounds manually and printed buffer size.
entries.rootCause: Indicator handle was re-initialized inside the event loop without resizing the array buffer.
entries.fix: Moved handle initialization to OnInit() and applied ArraySetAsSeries() before accessing rates.
entries.lesson: <>Always separate indicator handle allocation from the tick execution logic.

entries.title: OnTradeTransaction missing fill notification during slippage
entries.symptom: Pending orders execution state remains unverified during fast market events.
entries.tried: Added OrderSelect() polling loop inside OnTick().
entries.rootCause: Trade transaction events were dropping due to unhandled TRADE_TRANSACTION_DEAL_ADD state transitions.
entries.fix: Refactored OnTradeTransaction to explicitly filter for TRADE_TRANSACTION_DEAL_ADD and check deal entry type.
entries.lesson: Rely on explicit transaction deal types in OnTradeTransaction rather than polling order history.

entries.title: DuckDB timestamp timezone mismatch on parquet join
entries.symptom: SQL queries fail with mismatch error between UTC and localized timestamps.
entries.tried: Attempted string casting with strftime() inside SQL queries.
entries.rootCause: DuckDB inferred microsecond precision with local offset from raw tick inputs, conflicting with ZSTD Parquet schema.
entries.fix: Standardized all ingested timestamps to epoch milliseconds UTC using explicitly typed schema definitions.
entries.lesson: Enforce UTC epoch normalization at ingestion time before writing to Parquet repositories.

entries.title: Vectorbt lookahead bias in rolling ATR calculation
entries.symptom: Backtest produces unrealistically high Sharpe ratio during volatile market regimes.
entries.tried: Re-indexed price matrices and adjusted stop-loss percentage multipliers.
entries.rootCause: Indicator shift parameter was omitted, allowing signal generation using current bar close instead of prior bar close.
entries.fix: Applied .shift(1) to trailing volatility indicators before generating entry signals.
entries.lesson: Always verify lag operators on feature matrices to eliminate lookahead bias in vectorised engine calculations.

entries.title: Backtrader order execution mismatch on gap opens
entries.symptom: Stop-loss orders fill at exact trigger price instead of opening gapped price.
entries.tried: Overrode next() method and forced market orders on current bar.
entries.rootCause: Cheat-on-open parameter was enabled by default in broker execution settings.
entries.fix: Set cheat_on_open=False and configured realistic slip_open=True slippage models.
entries.lesson: Ensure realistic broker settings for gap-handling during event-driven backtesting execution.

entries.title: PostgreSQL Walk-Forward connection exhaustion
entries.symptom: Database connection pool drops workers with FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved error.
entries.rootCause: Parallel optimization tasks failed to release pooled connections upon worker process completion.
entries.fix: Implemented context-managed connection pool wrapper with explicit client cleanup in try/finally blocks.
entries.lesson: Always manage worker node database lifecycle with context managers during multi-process jobs.

entries.title: WSL2 disk space growth during heavy DuckDB queries
entries.symptom: Ubuntu WSL virtual disk image expands rapidly and exhausts host C: drive space.
entries.tried: Ran apt clean and deleted temporary parquet logs.
entries.rootCause: DuckDB temporary storage spilled to /tmp directory on VHDX without automated shrinking.
entries.fix: Configured temp_directory setting in DuckDB to point to dedicated external mount and ran disk compacting in PowerShell.
entries.lesson: Redirect database spill directories away from the default root WSL filesystem.

entries.title: Uncaught TypeError in async fetch rendering loop
entries.symptom: DOM rendering halts with Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'title').
entries.rootCause: JSON API response wrapped entries inside an object instead of returning a top-level array.
entries.fix: Updated parsing logic to extract response.data.entries before invoking Array.prototype.forEach().
entries.lesson: Validate payload structure or apply optional chaining before iterating fetched JSON data.

entries.title: ESM import statement failure in Node/Mocha test runner
entries.symptom: SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module.
entries.tried: Converted import statements to require() statements.
entries.rootCause: package.json missing "type": "module" declaration for ECMAScript module resolution.
entries.fix: Added "type": "module" to package.json and ensured explicit .js file extensions on local relative imports.
entries.lesson: Explicitly specify module target settings in Node environments when using ES6 import/export syntax.
